declaration.source: UCI HAR README.txt (archive SHA-256 c00b803081a5c797cd5e4b83700a9810b38d53d9d84e01917e090e1fdbc81031): each of 30 volunteers performed the activities wearing a smartphone; the signals 'were sampled in fixed-width sliding windows of 2.56 sec and 50% overlap (128 readings/window)'; the volunteers were partitioned into training and test sets. declaration.statement: Every window is cut from one volunteer's own recording, so a window can overlap only windows of the same subject (subject_id). Subject-disjoint folds therefore keep every pair of overlapping windows on one side of the split.
